infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: This app needs access to camera to take photos of hand-drawn workflow diagrams.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: This app needs access to microphone to record voice instructions for creating and editing AI agents.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: This app needs access to photo library to select workflow diagrams.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Nodara to access your camera to photograph workflow diagrams.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Nodara to access your microphone to create and edit agent instructions.
